scope: Local written/subprocess-tested adapter only; no installation, live/fleet proof or A claim.

extra.result: {"content": "1|# Fixture connector card\n2|Synthetic read-only example, not a live account or server.", "total_lines": 2, "file_size": 84, "truncated": false}

runtime_prerequisites: POSIX Python 3 (fcntl); JSON-formatted YAML mode needs stdlib only.
General YAML requires PyYAML in the SAME Python interpreter used by the hook command. Current local python3 has no PyYAML; general-YAML branch is unverified.
Active HERMES_HOME must exactly match policy.home; profile payload must exactly match policy.profile.
Operator policy/routes and state directory must be protected from tool/user-controlled alteration.
Use local filesystem paths visible to the hook host; remote/container read mapping is unsupported.
setup: Copy hermes_guard.py to the operator-selected installation path. Do not install from this fixture without review.

Create operator policy JSON using actual active profile home, cards_dir and state_dir (absolute nonsymlink paths). Route keys must be exact discovered MCP names. The github/get_issue example is synthetic native-shaped data, not live discovery.

Generate the hooks block with python3 -B <installed-script> --policy <policy.json> --print-hook-config. Merge the generated hooks into that profile config.yaml; do not replace existing settings. Use an absolute operator-selected Python interpreter if PATH is uncertain.

Set HERMES_HOME to active profile home using the normal Hermes profile launcher. Consent to these exact hook commands through the normal Hermes approval flow. No auto-accept was added. Restart/reload the appropriate Hermes runtime to load configuration.

Load MCP credential values through the existing operator-approved profile .env/secret source. Config may reference ${ENV} or ${env:ENV}; no credential values belong in this policy or handoff. This guard does not validate live secret availability.

Before an exact mapped MCP call, issue read_file(path=<absolute card path>,offset=1,limit=<enough for full file>). Read evidence is marked only after the native post result proves complete, unredacted matching content with stable pre/post hash.
Inspect state_dir/findings.json after post calls. Invalid on-disk assets request action:continue at pre_verify, when Hermes actually emits that bounded event. Post results cannot veto or roll back.
custom_skill_policy: name is lowercase letters/digits/hyphens, <=64 chars, equals folder name
description >=20 characters and contains literal Use when
inline/reference-definition local links go to nonempty direct files within at most one subdirectory; no self, escape, symlink or chained local links
bare prose and dynamic references are not resolved; these are custom checks, not native Hermes limits
supported: full write_file overwrites of active home/config.yaml or home/skills/**/SKILL.md, pre-simulated and post/pre_verify rechecked
local read_file; card proof is session+profile+home+path+content hash with pending pre snapshot; native extra.tool_call_id when present, single pending session/file when absent
exact configured nonaggregate MCP route keys with enabled native mcp_servers entry and current successful card-read proof
MCP env/header placeholders, Authorization Bearer placeholder, HTTPS URL or simple stdio command template
unsupported: skill_manage flat actions and every operations batch
COMPOSIO_MULTI_EXECUTE_TOOL and other aggregate tools; aggregate-shaped args on any mapped route denied as a whole
terminal, patch, execute_code, delegation, manage_connections, unknown tools/MCP routes
append writes, arbitrary files/supporting-file authoring, external/project/plugin skills, nonlocal file mappings
unsupported MCP server options/transports, shell command wrappers, credential command arguments, plaintext env/header values
no pre-write protection for terminal arbitrary edits or out-of-band mutations; terminal dispatch is denied, not simulated
post_tool_call is observer-only; pre_verify continuation is bounded and not guaranteed to fire on every change
unapproved/skipped hooks, startup MCP server launches outside tool dispatch, other plugin modifications and same-user tampering not covered
